newsitem.title: USA: Mark IV sells Vapor unit, sees $17 mln gain.
newsitem.headline: Mark IV sells Vapor unit, sees $17 mln gain.

text.p: Mark IV Industries Inc said Thursday it would sell Vapor Corp to Westinghouse Air Brake Company for $66.4 million, including $64.4 million in cash and $2 million in future sales-related performance payments.
Mark IV said it will realize a pre-tax gain of about $17 million on the sale.
Vapor is the first of several transportation units Mark IV said it is in the process of divesting. The unit had revenue of about $65 million in the fiscal year ended February 29.
Cash proceeds will be used to reduce bank debt and eventually pooled with the proceeds of other divestments to finance acquisitions or repurchase company stock, the company said.
Mark IV Industries makes power and fluid transfer systems and components for the automotive and other industries.
